session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Gap Up to Low 2 Then Upper and Lower Trading Ranges'. Overnight gap up to a low 2 high at 6040 forms double tops; a failed double bottom and triangle breakout sell down through consecutive sell climaxes to the opening-range measured move low at 6013, then a tight limit-order trading range reverses the close back up to 6033. Chart is on a 13 hr offset (ET+13) so printed times map to PT by subtracting 13 hours.
